fact: 1945年8月15日日本宣布接受《波茨坦公告》投降（美国称V-J日），9月2日在密苏里号正式签署投降书；美国战时经济随即进入复员与转产阶段。

sources.title: 战后亚太国际秩序的法律基石 | 人民网理论频道
sources.quote: 14日，日本国元首裕仁发表接受《波茨坦公告》的停战诏书，宣布无条件投降。9月2日，日本[签署投降书]。

fact: 战后复员并未如许多人担忧的那样酿成大萧条，但出现短暂收缩：到1946年初工业生产比1945年5月下降超过30%，制造业就业下降超过20%；失业率从欧战胜利日（VE-day）的约50万升至1946年2月的约270万。

sources.title: The Economic Situation at Midyear 1950 (Economic Report of the President) | FRASER, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
sources.quote: by early 1946 industrial production had declined more than 30 percent from the May 1945 level, and employment in manufacturing had decreased more than 20 percent. Unemployment rose from about one-half million on VE-day to about 2.7 million in February 1946.

fact: 1945年前后非农就业在两个季度之间下降超过300万；战时军需就业急剧收缩，但贸易、服务业等前劳动力短缺领域的就业增加与工时缩短部分抵消了这一下滑。

sources.title: February 1946 Survey of Current Business | Bureau of Economic Analysis（美国经济分析局）
sources.quote: Nonagricultural employment fell by more than 3 million between the first and final quarters.

fact: 1945年8月美国采用工资—物价政策，在取消加班费与转产导致周薪下降时释放工资管制（建筑业除外）以维持消费收入；物价管制于1946年11月10日按总统令基本取消，仅保留住宅租金与少数商品。

sources.title: Eighteenth Quarterly Report (period ended June 30, 1946) | Office of Price Administration, GovInfo
sources.quote: the wage-price policy of August 1945 was adopted... wages were released from direct control (except in the construction industry).

sources.title: Twentieth Quarterly Report (period ended Dec 31, 1946) | OPA, GovInfo
sources.quote: Price ceilings on most goods and services were discontinued by Presidential order as of November 10, 1946.

fact: 战后初期失业率从约50万升至约270万（1946年2月），制造业就业下降逾20%；复员带来的短暂失业与转产摩擦，是美国普通人1945–1946年的基本经济处境。

sources.title: The Economic Situation at Midyear 1950 | FRASER
sources.quote: Unemployment rose from about one-half million on VE-day to about 2.7 million in February 1946.

fact: 战后转产在某些领域较快推进：生产耐用消费品与建筑业较早转向民用产出；军需工业急剧收缩的同时，民用工业开始恢复，显示战时产能向消费品生产的转换。

sources.title: February 1946 Survey of Current Business | Bureau of Economic Analysis
sources.quote: In some areas-such as producers durable goods and construction-the shift to civilian output got under way fairly soon.
